title: In vitro Infection of SHK-1 Cell Cultures with the Intracellular Pathogen P. salmonis
author: Pamela Aravena

steps.title: Prepare bacterial media
steps.instruction: Make Nutrient Piscirickettsia Broth (NPB) containing 30 g L⁻¹ Tryptic Soy Broth, 256.6 mM NaCl, 8.25 mM L‑cysteine, and 37 µM FeCl₃; also prepare NPA plates by adding 1.5 % agar to NPB.

steps.title: Recover bacteria from frozen stock
steps.instruction: Inoculate NPB with frozen P. salmonis CGR02 stock, plate onto NPA, and incubate 5–7 days at 18 °C.

steps.title: Grow bacteria to desired phase
steps.instruction: Transfer a colony from the NPA plate into 5 mL NPB and incubate in a shaking incubator at 180 rpm, 18 °C for 36 h to obtain exponential‑phase bacteria or 96 h for stationary‑phase bacteria.

steps.title: Monitor bacterial growth
steps.instruction: Take an aliquot of the culture, measure optical density at 600 nm (OD₆₀₀) and count cells with a Neubauer improved counting chamber; use these data to calculate the multiplicity of infection (MOI).

steps.title: Verify bacterial purity
steps.instruction: Perform Gram staining and the PCR‑RFLP assay described by Mandakovic et al. to confirm culture purity before harvesting.

steps.title: Prepare SHK‑1 culture medium
steps.instruction: Use Leibovitz's L‑15 medium supplemented with 5 % inactivated fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 40 µM 2‑mercaptoethanol; keep the medium at 18 °C.

steps.title: Seed SHK‑1 cells
steps.instruction: Plate SHK‑1 cells (ECACC N° 97111106) at 3.5 × 10⁵ cells per T‑25 flask or 3 × 10⁵ cells per well of a 6‑well plate to reach ~80 % confluence.

steps.title: Pre‑infection incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the seeded SHK‑1 cells overnight at 18 °C.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial inoculum
steps.instruction: Harvest stationary‑phase bacteria (or heat‑inactivate a control batch at 65 °C for 60 min) and adjust the suspension to achieve an MOI of 100 : 1 (bacteria : cell).

steps.title: Infect SHK‑1 cells
steps.instruction: Add the bacterial suspension to the SHK‑1 monolayer and incubate at 18 °C for 3 days.

steps.title: Eliminate extracellular bacteria
steps.instruction: Wash infected cells with cold PBS 1X, then add L‑15 medium containing gentamicin 100 µg mL⁻¹ and incubate 40 min at 18 °C.

steps.title: Restore antibiotic‑free culture
steps.instruction: Wash cells again with PBS 1X and replace medium with fresh L‑15 supplemented with 5 % FBS (no antibiotics).

steps.title: Monitor infection daily
steps.instruction: Observe the infected cultures each day post‑infection (dpi) using an inverted optical microscope.

steps.title: Quantify vacuole‑containing cells
steps.instruction: At each desired time point, capture at least six representative bright‑field images per assay (two independent infection assays), analyze them with the NIS‑elements program (Nikon), and calculate the percentage of SHK‑1 cells containing P. salmonis vacuoles.
